notes.title: Keep Your Politics Bundle now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12510567/4e0df43a1a244143aaa90b97f8565cb8c156e7b4.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20653/

[h2]“Politics is not a game, but a serious business.” Winston Churchill.
[/h2]

We’re very excited to announce the launch of the Keep Your Politics bundle of six indie games. There’s a 10% discount for the entire bundle - and each game has a special sale price available (for a limited time) to compound your savings as we celebrate the launch of this awesome bundle of acclaimed titles.

It’s a Complete-The-Set bundle so you only pay for the games you don't yet own.

These games span a variety of gameplay genres and tell stories from different spaces and times - imagined and real. But all of them have important messages to share about the powers controlling politics and the people trying to survive its effects.

Take a look at the amazing games we have in the Keep Your Politics bundle:

[list]
[*] [h3]Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You
[*] Not Tonight   
[*] 1979 Revolution: Black Friday
[*] Headliner: NoviNews  
[*] Bury Me, My Love
[*] Orwell's Animal Farm[/h3]
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing: Fire Escape
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12510567/bd4ea788535da5b973e57c27f7274d9b1d46d1b1.jpg[/img]

Steam friends, today we are very excited to share that our newest title,[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1224480/Fire_Escape/] [b]FIRE ESCAPE[/b] [/url]will be releasing on Steam next Wednesday, April 29th! 

[previewyoutube=mKFv1-cquRA;full][/previewyoutube]

Fire Escape is a narrative game inspired by Hitchcock’s anxiety driven storytelling. Set in Crown Heights, Brooklyn - when the night strikes eight o’clock, a suspenseful muder-mystery begins to unfold in real time. 

It’s best described as what happens when “Immersive theatre meets game design.” Players have free roam to choose which apartment to spy on, but for every story beat you see, you miss many more. In Fire Escape, the details truly matter. 

With over five hours of motion capture performances, Fire Escape’s story is told in three replayable episodes of twenty minutes each. Launching with support for both Steam VR (Valve Index, HTC Vive, Oculus Rift) and Non-VR (Windows, no headset required), Fire Escape is also compatible with Steam Achievements.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1224480/Fire_Escape/

With the tragic impact of Covid-19 on New York City, our home, [b]we are also pledging to give 25% of all proceeds from Fire Escape to Covid Relief Funds that will help support, feed, and shelter the very people Fire Escape’s story features, and are at risk of being left behind during these extraordinary times.[/b] 

To celebrate the launch, we've made a special sale of 1979 Revolution: Black Friday at 50% discount until next Tuesday. If you haven't joined the revolution yet, there's no better time!

We hope you enjoy escaping to Crown Heights for a night of voyeurism, mystery and murder. Starting April 29th, stay home, spy on your neighbors, and help raise funds for Covid Relief!

notes.title: Game Sales to benefit the ACLU until Feb 10th!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12510567/22861d3eb7a60872be2d6768c6cde4b3ebff9b96.png[/img]

Hi Steam Friends,

We're a company of immigrants, from many different countries, who have all come to America to pursue our dreams of making games that are fun, valuable, and try to make the world a little better place. We made 1979 Revolution: Black Friday to show people a different point of view, to have them engage with a different culture, and to discover the similarities we all share.

In response to President Trump's executive order on immigration ban - we're donating all proceeds from iNK Stories' to the ACLU Nationwide until Feb 10th.

Now more than ever, empathy and dialogue is important, and we hope that 1979 Revolution: Black Friday is just one example of the many different ways we can all express our diversity and common humanity.

Thanks!

iNK Stories

notes.title: Spanish, French, German, Farsi, Russian, & Turkish Localization Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam Friends,

We are very excited to announce that subtitles and UI are all localized for 6 new languages:  [b]Spanish, French, German, Farsi, Russian & Turkish![/b]

We've been working very hard on this for the past few months - our primary goal with 1979 was to share it with as many different cultures as possible, and this is a BIG step forward in that commitment to make it a global community.

To change your language navigate to the "Options" menu on the Main Menu and select your language from the dropdown list.

To celebrate this big moment, we've made our [b]Game + Soundtrack edition 50% off for the next week[/b] - if you haven't picked up 1979 Revolution: Black Friday there's no better time than right now! 

If you have any bugs or localization errors, please let us know [url=steamcommunity.com/app/388320/discussions/4/]here at our new localization discussion forum[/url]

notes.title: Soundtrack Edition Flash Sale and Behind-The-Scenes Series!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam friends!

This week only the Game + Soundtrack Edition is 50% off until next Monday as a weekly sale! Take advantage of this great deal to check out 1979 Revolution: Black Friday if you haven't already!

We also wanted to let you all know we're starting a weekly Behind The Scenes series hosted on "Made With Unity" where we'll be talking about the different processes of making 1979 Revolution and our experience as a development team making the game.

Check out our first two entries:
[b]Motion Capture Mania[/b]: https://madewith.unity.com/stories/motion-capture-mania

Many of you are asking about localization and subtitles, we're hard at work right now to implement additional languages into the game, stay tuned as we'll have more information to share soon.

Thanks for your continued support!

-iNK Stories

notes.title: 1979 Revolution Soundtrack Edition now Available!
notes.notes:
We're very excited to announce the release of our official soundtrack for 1979 Revolution: Black Friday by our incredible composer Nima Fakhrara is now available in digital format on Steam with 21 original tracks from the game!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/MfGFyhu.jpg[/img]

The album is available as stand-alone DLC but we've also created a great bundle offering that packages the game and the album together at a discount so you get the whole package at a great deal for $15.99. To celebrate the launch, this Soundtrack Edition is available at a [b]30% discount for THIS WEEK ONLY[/b] so be sure to take advantage of this offering if you haven't purchased the game yet!

For those of you who have already bought & played 1979 Revolution: Black Friday, we're very, very grateful for your support - [b]so we've made the album FREE for those of you who have already purchased the game[/b] (before today) - the album should automatically download for you, but if not make sure to go to your downloads and enable the application to update.

Thanks again for the ongoing support, hope you all enjoy the music of the revolution!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 4/19/2016
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

A patch is now live for 1979 Revolution: Black Friday that fixes and improves a bunch of various issues/bugs we've seen occurring.

[h1]Changelist:[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Unity project has been upgraded from Unity 5.2.2 to Unity 5.3.4! This should resolve issues on older graphics cards crashing at scene 1 due to post-processing effects. 
[*]Fixed issues relating to stories and photos being unlockable at the wrong sections of the game. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the player could take a photo in the Black Friday scene before they were intended to, which would make progression behave strangely. 
[*]Fixed an issue where gameplay would continue behind UI if the user entered the stories book from the photo review screen in certain situations. 
[*]Fixed multiple issues regarding users being unable to unlock progress achievements or track stat progress.
[*]Fixed multiple issues regarding blank or mis-firing subtitles. 
[*]Fixed an issue relating to two Steam accounts on the same computer preventing achievement unlocking. 
[*]All rapid tap prompts and the pressure mini-game for a specific character's trauma mini-game can now be performed using the Spacebar key. [b] Rapid Tap QTE can now be performed with the spacebar key.[/b]
[*]Adjusted certain UI elements to prevent buttons or menu items to disappear at 2k+ resolutions due to UI scaling. 
[*]Added UI to inspection camera buttons to better indicate when a object was interactive or not. 
[*]Fixed a variety of minor gameplay bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: 1979 Revolution Developer Diary - Motion Capture
notes.notes:
Hi Steam Friends!

Thanks so much for all the kind words and discussions over the last week - we're so happy people are discovering and playing the game and we can't wait to see the revolution continue to grow in the coming weeks.

Some of you have been asking about the making of the game. We're happy to announce the start of our developer's diary series where we'll be showing you behind the scenes footage of the process we went through to bring [b]1979 Revolution: Black Friday[/b] to life.

The first part is all about motion-capture and the process we went through to create the cinematics that make up a large part of the game. Check out the video below for a side-by-side comparison between the game and the motion-capture.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zjlhgtjTYqY

[url=1979thegame.tumblr.com/post/142710435577/1979motioncapture]You can read the entire feature on our blog.[/url] 

Be sure to follow us there to stay updated! Thanks!
